review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-25. CH + H2SS: sulfur donor plus the CH frontier span. The repaired v8 near and 30 angstrom compact CASSCF outputs in both bases retain valence character. Source canonical 17,18,21,22; selected near natural 19-22. Selected from native occupations and AO coefficients, not an energy-window rule. These fixed-geometry CASSCF screens select a production model; they do not establish quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular or asymptotic-plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital, root and connectivity checks. State averaging is optimization support; only D1 contributes reactive flux. Direct CASPT2-F12 uses avdz-f12/avtz-f12 CBS power 3.7 and the separate 30 angstrom asymptote.
